messages:
sara: Hi team, I'm booking parental leave (expected baby due 2026-07-08). What's the latest date to submit docs so payroll doesn't miss first paycheck?

mira (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: For planned births, upload docs within 10 business days of filing the request, but to be safe submit 3 weeks before leave start. Payroll syncs each Monday. If docs land after payroll cutoff we can still process but there may be a one-paycheck lag.

devon: From an ops side can we get a short 'emergency contact' + 3 critical runbooks before the leave starts? A two-hour overlap with you is great if possible.

sara: Yes I can do a 2hr overlap and will add runbooks. Which format do you want the contacts in?

mira (People Ops): A tiny doc in the portal 'coverage plan' box is enough: name, role, phone/email. Also flag any HIPAA/customer confidentiality notes. You can upload PDFs or photos.

people-ops-bot: reminder: "Submit leave request in HR portal and upload supporting docs. Payroll cutoff: 2026-06-21 for July pay period."

devon: We'll set up an automated rotation in PagerDuty and pin the playbook in the repo.

sara: Thanks — I'll file the portal request today and ping @mira with the payroll case number once I get it.

mira (People Ops): I'll review once it's in and send a checklist: payroll confirmation, benefits continuation, and expected return-date capture. DM if you want a phased return template.

sara: Awesome, appreciate it! :heart:
